_note: v2 hook overrides for la Tour de l'Horloge (B03_horloge): only where the painted scene differs from the source hook.

fr_vendredi_noun.hook: "VAN-DRUH-DEE" ("vahn-druh-DEE"): the fishmonger pushes his little blue fish cart, a tiny VAN of fish: fish day, FRIDAY.
fr_vendredi_noun.why: The painting shows a small blue handcart of fish rather than a motor van.

fr_canicule_noun.hook: "CAN-EE-COOL" ("ka-nee-KUL"): a sweltering girl fans herself and clutches a CAN of something COOL; the thermometer is in the red. A HEATWAVE.
fr_canicule_noun.why: The painting shows a girl, not a woman.

fr_fin_noun.hook: "FAN" ("FAN"): the girl gives her FAN one last flourish. That's THE END of the show.
fr_fin_noun.why: The painted fan is open, not being snapped shut.

fr_soir_noun.hook: A SWAN ("SWAHR") glides on the little fountain pond as the day draws to a close: it is EVENING.
fr_soir_noun.why: The repainted square shows the swan on a fountain pond, with no street lamp.

fr_matin_noun.hook: "MAT-TAN" ("ma-TAN"): a man does sunrise yoga on his MAT as the sun comes up behind him: MORNING.
fr_matin_noun.why: The repainted square has no rooster.

fr_demain_adv.hook: "DUH-MAN" ("duh-MAN"): THE MAN's case is packed and his alarm clock is set on top of it, ready for TOMORROW.
fr_demain_adv.why: The alcove shows the packed suitcase and alarm clock without the man.

fr_reprise_noun.hook: "RE-PRIZE" ("ruh-PREEZ"): a girl holds her trophy up high. She won the PRIZE AGAIN, a REPEAT.
fr_reprise_noun.why: The music room shows one trophy.

fr_initiation_noun.hook: "ee-nee-sya-SYON": a girl kneels holding a wooden sword, ready for her very first lesson. Her INITIATION.
fr_initiation_noun.why: The terrace shows the girl kneeling with the sword, without a knight.

fr_introduction_noun.hook: "an-tro-duk-SYON": microphone in hand, she waves hello for the INTRODUCTION: "Let me introduce myself."
fr_introduction_noun.why: The terrace shows her waving rather than shaking hands.
